name: Wanderer
short_desc: The trail catalogue that makes your GPS data searchable
author: Flomp
description: wanderer is a self-hosted trail database. You can upload your recorded tracks or create new ones and add various metadata to build an easily searchable catalogue.

form_fields.label: PocketBase proxy secret
form_fields.hint: Shared secret the web and db services authenticate inbound ActivityPub deliveries with. Required since v0.21.0.
